usage: agentware trust rotate [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                              [--principal PRINCIPAL] [--key-file KEY_FILE]
                              [--from-repo] [--valid-after VALID_AFTER]
                              [--valid-before VALID_BEFORE]
                              [--comment COMMENT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --principal PRINCIPAL
                        signer identity (default: agentware-release)
  --key-file KEY_FILE   path to the publisher SSH pubkey file
  --from-repo           pin the in-tree published key (catalog/agentware-
                        release.pub)
  --valid-after VALID_AFTER
                        SSH valid-after (e.g. 20260101 or 20260101000000)
  --valid-before VALID_BEFORE
                        SSH valid-before (overlap-window retirement)
  --comment COMMENT     optional key comment
